checks.name: Eight actual registrations have exact typed states and distinct compatible branch mappings
Known host inputs preserve fractional movement, 24-hour wrap and negative offsets
Clock ticks use actual imported hands/segments and leave revisions, saved bytes and navigation unchanged
Latest time applies to a previously prepared appearance and restore/view changes without transaction conflicts
Digital power, brightness and offset are independently saved and do not mutate another instance
Invalid time and state fail before replacing the live scene, input or saved configuration

limits: CPU tests consume real imported GLBs; browser process restart, visual evidence and ordinary-PC performance are separate.
